name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.networkM_cost
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (ids : List.{0} Nat),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.networkM g ids))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.networkCL g ids)

source.code:
theorem networkM_cost (ids : List ℕ) : (g.networkM ids).cost = g.networkCL ids := by
  simp only [networkM, networkCL, appendsCL, bind_cost, pure_cost, tick_cost,
    netNodesM_val, nodeArcsM_val, edgeArcsM_val, srcArcsM_val, snkArcsM_val, netSM_val, netTM_val,
    netNodesM_cost, nodeArcsM_cost, edgeArcsM_cost, srcArcsM_cost, snkArcsM_cost, netSM_cost,
    netTM_cost]
  omega

g : GInstance
ids : List ℕ
⊢ g.netNodesCL ids +
      (g.nodeArcsCL ids +
        (g.edgeArcsCL ids +
          (g.srcArcsCL ids +
            (g.snkArcsCL ids +
              ((g.nodeArcsL ids).length +
                ((g.nodeArcsL ids ++ g.edgeArcsL ids).length +
                  ((g.nodeArcsL ids ++ g.edgeArcsL ids ++ g.srcArcsL ids).length + (g.netSC + (g.netSC + 0))))))))) =
    g.netNodesCL ids + g.nodeArcsCL ids + g.edgeArcsCL ids + g.srcArcsCL ids + g.snkArcsCL ids +
        ((g.nodeArcsL ids).length + (g.nodeArcsL ids ++ g.edgeArcsL ids).length +
          (g.nodeArcsL ids ++ g.edgeArcsL ids ++ g.srcArcsL ids).length) +
      2 * g.netSC
